parsed.visual_overview: A split-screen video featuring a young woman playing two roles. On the right, she acts as a tired learner speaking Marathi. On the left, wearing a fake mustache, she acts as a confident friend translating her sentences into English. The video ends with a call to action for Supernova AI.
